blocks.text: Zscaler Deception supports the OpenAPI specification for Orchestrate, Miragemaker, Deceive, Landmine, Investigate, and Settings features.
API Tokens provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Programmatically configure and deploy decoys, manage event logs and evidence, configure Miragemaker datasets and personalities, etc.

blocks.text: On the API Tokens page (Orchestrate > API Tokens), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of API tokens. For each API token configured, you can view:
Name: The name of the API token.
Description: The description of the API token.
Roles: The role assigned to the API token.
Created By: The ID of the user who created the API token.
Created On: The date and time when the API token was created.
Enabled: Indicates if the API token is enabled or disabled.
Status: Indicates if the API token is active or expired.
Edit or delete an API token.
